entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling that up... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the device?
It's just not what I thought it would be. It's confusing and I honestly expected more.
I understand. Can you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with how it works?
Preference, I guess. It's just really hard to use. I read the user manual and still couldn't figure out the settings I wanted. I just want to return it.
Okay, I see. No problem, let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you now.
Oh. Fine. You'll send a shipping label?

Yes, of course. I've just submitted the return authorization. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off.
Whatever. I guess that's one thing that works. I'll look for the email.
Perfect. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with, Alex?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
